subject: Life Skills
title: Questions That Open Doors
description: Learn Questions That Open Doors in one minute.

hook.text: 'What do you do?' gets a job title. 'What is keeping you busy these days?' gets a real conversation.

buildup.text: Closed questions get one-word answers. Open questions invite stories, opinions, and emotions.

discovery.text: Start questions with 'what' or 'how' instead of 'do' or 'did.' 'How did you get into that?' opens a much wider door.

twist.text: 'Why' questions can feel like interrogations. 'Why did you do that?' triggers defense.

climax.text: The best conversationalists ask fewer questions but better ones. One great question beats a dozen mediocre ones.

punchline.text: Ask how, not did. Watch people open up.

quiz.question: Why should you avoid starting questions with 'why'?
options: It is grammatically incorrect in conversation
It can feel like an interrogation and trigger defensiveness
People prefer questions about facts, not reasons
